reels.title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper directly aligns with our high-performing 'hardware_efficiency' category. The mechanism of multi-branch speculative decoding is visually intuitive for a 3Blue1Brown style: it's like a runner trying multiple paths simultaneously and only committing to the one that avoids a wall.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI didn't have to guess one word at a time, but could 'test-drive' five different futures before deciding?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A mountain hiker sending out scouts to test different trails before committing the whole group to one path.
